services.name: Sailing Lessons
services.desc: There's nothing better than being out on the water. Whether new to sailing or a developing mariner, we offer a variety of lesson options to help navigate your route. Discover the thrill of harnessing the wind and setting sail across the water with Regatta Point Community Sailing in Hopkinton and Worcester. Our adult sailing classes are your gateway to adventure-whether you’re brand new or ready to grow your skills. From your first tack to mastering the helm, you’ll gain confidence, build lasting memories, and join a vibrant community of sailors. Boat Rentals
services.desc: Experience the beauty of Central Massachusetts from the water with our affordable kayak, paddleboard, and canoe rentals. Available at both our Worcester and Hopkinton locations, our rental equipment provides the perfect way to enjoy a peaceful paddle, get some exercise, or have fun with family and friends. Rentals require a 1-hour minimum but are prorated in 15-minute increments after the first hour. Three hour rentals are available, charge is 2x the hourly rate and Day rentals charge 4x the hourly rate. Young adults ages 16 to 17 may rent boats with a parent or guardian’s signature.
